scope: Known limitations of the initial whole-history metadata consolidation

gaps.detail: The reset report describes the original bulk and its later removal. Curated primary evidence and compact route histories remain; this importer preserves those registry references without claiming restoration of removed original decisions.
The initial index has 870 entries spanning GDT001 through GDT871, with GDT256 absent. No experiment record or explanation is fabricated.

Five-source metadata preservation is complete. Independent meaning-hypothesis identity, links between renamed variants and adjudication of superseded findings are not inferred automatically. Unreviewed records remain searchable and are reconciled when relevant.
